15	/// Produces HTML nodes from content contained in an HTML element that is
16	/// block-level by default.
17	#[typst_macros::time(name = "html block fragment")]
18	pub fn html_block_fragment(
19	    engine: &mut Engine,
20	    content: &Content,
21	    locator: Locator,
22	    styles: StyleChain,
23	    whitespace: Whitespace,
24	) -> SourceResult<EcoVec<HtmlNode>> {
25	    html_block_fragment_impl(
26	        engine.world,
27	        engine.library,
28	        engine.introspector.into_raw(),
29	        engine.traced,

40	#[comemo::memoize]
41	#[expect(clippy::too_many_arguments)]
42	fn html_block_fragment_impl(
43	    world: Tracked<dyn World + '_>,
44	    library: &LazyHash<Library>,
45	    introspector: Tracked<dyn Introspector + '_>,
46	    traced: Tracked<Traced>,
47	    sink: TrackedMut<Sink>,
48	    route: Tracked<Route>,
49	    content: &Content,
50	    locator: Tracked<Locator>,
51	    styles: StyleChain,
52	    whitespace: Whitespace,
53	) -> SourceResult<EcoVec<HtmlNode>> {
54	    let introspector = Protected::from_raw(introspector);
55	    let link = LocatorLink::new(locator);
56	    let mut locator = Locator::link(&link).split();
57	    let mut engine = Engine {
58	        library,
59	        world,
60	        introspector,
61	        traced,
62	        sink,
63	        route: Route::extend(route),
64	    };
65	
66	    engine.route.check_html_depth().at(content.span())?;
67	
68	    let arenas = Arenas::default();
69	    let children = realize_fragment(&mut engine, &mut locator, &arenas, content, styles)?;
70	    crate::convert::convert_to_nodes(
71	        &mut engine,
72	        &mut locator,
73	        children.iter().copied(),
74	        ConversionLevel::Block,
75	        whitespace,
76	    )
77	}

79	/// Produces HTML nodes from content contained in an HTML element that is
80	/// inline-level by default.
81	///
82	/// The difference to block-level content is that inline-level content has
83	/// shared smartquoting state with surrounding inline-level content. This
84	/// requires mutable state, which is at odds with memoization. However, the
85	/// caching granularity would be unnecessarily high anyway if every single
86	/// fragment was cached, so this works out pretty well together.
87	#[typst_macros::time(name = "html inline fragment")]
88	pub fn html_inline_fragment(
89	    engine: &mut Engine,
90	    content: &Content,
91	    locator: &mut SplitLocator,
92	    quoter: &mut SmartQuoter,
93	    styles: StyleChain,
94	    whitespace: Whitespace,
95	) -> SourceResult<EcoVec<HtmlNode>> {
96	    engine.route.increase();
97	    engine.route.check_html_depth().at(content.span())?;
98	
99	    let arenas = Arenas::default();
100	    let children = realize_fragment(engine, locator, &arenas, content, styles)?;
101	    let result = crate::convert::convert_to_nodes(
102	        engine,
103	        locator,
104	        children.iter().copied(),
105	        ConversionLevel::Inline(quoter),
106	        whitespace,
107	    );
108	
109	    engine.route.decrease();
110	    result
111	}
112	
113	/// Produces HTML nodes from content contained in a MathML element.
114	///
115	/// Uses math realization so that paragraph grouping doesn't occur.
116	#[typst_macros::time(name = "html math fragment")]
117	pub fn html_math_fragment(
118	    engine: &mut Engine,
119	    content: &Content,
120	    locator: &mut SplitLocator,
121	    quoter: &mut SmartQuoter,
122	    styles: StyleChain,
123	    whitespace: Whitespace,
124	) -> SourceResult<EcoVec<HtmlNode>> {
125	    engine.route.increase();
126	    engine.route.check_html_depth().at(content.span())?;
127	
128	    let arenas = Arenas::default();
129	    let children = (engine.library.routines.realize)(
130	        RealizationKind::Math,
131	        engine,
132	        locator,
133	        &arenas,
134	        content,
135	        styles,
136	    )?;
137	    let result = crate::convert::convert_to_nodes(
138	        engine,
139	        locator,
140	        children.iter().copied(),
141	        ConversionLevel::Inline(quoter),
142	        whitespace,
143	    );
144	
145	    engine.route.decrease();
146	    result
147	}

149	/// Realizes the body of an HTML fragment.
150	fn realize_fragment<'a>(
151	    engine: &mut Engine,
152	    locator: &mut SplitLocator,
153	    arenas: &'a Arenas,
154	    content: &'a Content,
155	    styles: StyleChain<'a>,
156	) -> SourceResult<Vec<Pair<'a>>> {
157	    (engine.library.routines.realize)(
158	        RealizationKind::Fragment {
159	            // We ignore the `FragmentKind` because we handle both uniformly.
160	            kind: &mut FragmentKind::Block,
161	        },
162	        engine,
163	        locator,
164	        arenas,
165	        content,
166	        styles,
167	    )
168	}

我现在已经对 `typst-html` crate 有了透彻的了解。在生成 manifest 之前，让我整理一下我的理解。

**架构摘要**（总共约 7500 行代码，18 个源文件）：
- `lib.rs`: 模块根目录 + 用户元素 `html.elem`/`html.frame`
- `dom.rs`: DOM 数据模型 (`HtmlDocument`/`HtmlNode`/`HtmlElement`/`HtmlTag`/`HtmlAttr`/`HtmlFrame`)
- `document.rs`: 编译流水线 (`html_document` → 实现 → `finalize_dom` → 样式 → 锚点)
- `convert.rs`: 内容→节点转换器 + 空白处理
- `fragment.rs`: 递归块/行内/数学片段 (memoization)
- `rules.rs`: 内置显示规则 (Typst→HTML 元素映射)
- `encode.rs`: DOM→HTML 字符串序列化
- `css/`: 属性 + `ToCss` + 内联样式解析
- `property.rs`: `Display` + UA 默认值
- `tag.rs`/`attr.rs`/`typed.rs`: 常量 + 内容模型 + 生成的类型化 API
- `charsets.rs`/`introspect.rs`/`link.rs`/`mathml.rs`: 字符有效性、内省、链接锚点、MathML

这将形成 6 个单元、27 篇教程的内容，按照“项目→数据模型→流水线→机制→专家主题→专业化”的清晰依赖链进行规划。

input.rationale: typst-html 是 Typst 的 HTML 导出器，核心职责是把 Typst 文档编译为 HTML 字符串，本 crate 约 7500 行、18 个源文件，属于中大型 crate，故规划 6 单元共 27 篇讲义。学习路线按「先认识项目与入口、再吃透 DOM 数据模型、接着走通编译与转换主链路、然后深入空白/display/CSS 等核心机制、最后攻克制码与内省/链接/数学等专家主题」逐层递进。第一单元让读者从零建立全局认知（定位、模块树、CLI 调用链、用户 API）；第二单元打牢 HtmlDocument/HtmlNode/HtmlTag/HtmlAttr 及类型化 API 等 DOM 数据结构基础；第三单元串起 realization→convert_to_nodes→finalize_dom→encode 的编译主流程与 show 规则注册；第四单元聚焦浏览器正确渲染所必需的空白保护、display 提升、CSS 属性系统与类型转换；第五单元覆盖字符串编码、字符转义、HTML 内省查询、链接锚点与 MathML 转换；第六单元以 html.frame/SVG、表格与图片导出、类型化属性系统、comemo 缓存等专题收尾。讲义之间通过 depends_on 形成由数据结构到流程、由流程到细节的单向依赖，便于读者按序阅读。

data.head: 146a58329a30f6cd38978c22c6bf0e430d8962a1
data.rationale: typst-html 是 Typst 的 HTML 导出器，核心职责是把 Typst 文档编译为 HTML 字符串，本 crate 约 7500 行、18 个源文件，属于中大型 crate，故规划 6 单元共 27 篇讲义。学习路线按「先认识项目与入口、再吃透 DOM 数据模型、接着走通编译与转换主链路、然后深入空白/display/CSS 等核心机制、最后攻克制码与内省/链接/数学等专家主题」逐层递进。第一单元让读者从零建立全局认知（定位、模块树、CLI 调用链、用户 API）；第二单元打牢 HtmlDocument/HtmlNode/HtmlTag/HtmlAttr 及类型化 API 等 DOM 数据结构基础；第三单元串起 realization→convert_to_nodes→finalize_dom→encode 的编译主流程与 show 规则注册；第四单元聚焦浏览器正确渲染所必需的空白保护、display 提升、CSS 属性系统与类型转换；第五单元覆盖字符串编码、字符转义、HTML 内省查询、链接锚点与 MathML 转换；第六单元以 html.frame/SVG、表格与图片导出、类型化属性系统、comemo 缓存等专题收尾。讲义之间通过 depends_on 形成由数据结构到流程、由流程到细节的单向依赖，便于读者按序阅读。
